overall_assessment: Section splitting for inn is mostly good: course_content, teaching_methods, coursework_requirements and prerequisites land in the right sections. Two systematic defects remain. On English-language plans, learning_outcomes is reduced to the one-line intro sentence (the Knowledge/Skills/General competence lists are lost), and assessment is polluted with the language-of-instruction line while the real 'Form of assessment' description is lost. Generic placeholders are also emitted as reading_list rows.

findings.evidence: Upon successful completion of the course, the student will have achieved the following learning outcomes:
findings.description: In the English-heading plans (Learning outcome / Knowledge / Skills / General competence; all of courses 1-11, including one Norwegian-content course with English headings) learning_outcomes contains only the introductory sentence. All actual outcome statements ('has comprehensive knowledge about...', 'can analyse literary texts...') are dropped and do not appear in any other section, so the section is effectively empty. The Norwegian-heading plans (Læringsutbytte) keep the full lists, so this is specific to the English sub-heading set.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: English sub-headings 'Knowledge', 'Skills', 'General competence' (plus 'The student') are treated as section boundaries with no mapping, so everything after the intro line up to 'Working and teaching methods' is discarded. Norwegian 'Kunnskap/Ferdigheter/Generell kompetanse' are not treated as boundaries.
findings.suggested_fix: In R/section_heading_map.R / R/extract_sections.R, treat Knowledge, Skills, General competence (and Norwegian equivalents) as sub-headings that are absorbed into learning_outcomes rather than as boundaries or unmapped headings; or map them to learning_outcomes explicitly.

findings.evidence: English Form of assessment Grading scale Grouping Duration of assessment Support materials Proportion Comments Home examination ECTS - A-F Individual 3 Day(s) All 100
findings.description: On English-heading plans the assessment section starts with the language of instruction ('English' / 'Norwegian'), taken from the 'Language of instruction and examination' header field, which is not assessment content.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The heading 'Language of instruction and examination' matches an 'examination' pattern mapped to assessment, so its value is opened as an assessment section and then merged with the later exam table.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a pattern for 'Language of instruction( and examination)?' / 'Undervisnings- og eksamensspråk' mapped to a dropped/ignored section and place it before the generic exam/eksamen pattern so first match wins.

findings.evidence: Three day individual take-home exam, 4000 words.
findings.description: On English-heading plans the descriptive text under the second 'Form of assessment' heading (exam format, word limit, grading statement, pass requirements) is missing from assessment, which holds only the table header row. The Norwegian-heading plans keep this narrative ('Praksis har individuell vurdering og vurderes til Bestått/Ikke bestått.'). The dropped text does not appear in any other section.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The 'Form of assessment' sub-heading is unmapped or treated as a boundary to a dropped section in English plans, so the narrative after it is discarded; Norwegian 'Eksamen'/'Vurdering' repeats are handled.
findings.suggested_fix: Map 'Form of assessment' (and 'Examination') to assessment in R/section_heading_map.R so the repeated heading continues the same section instead of discarding its body.

findings.evidence: Vurderingsordning Karakterskala Gruppe/individuell Varighet Hjelpemidler Andel Kommentarer Praksis Bestått - Ikke bestått Individuell 100%
findings.description: The flattened exam-logistics table header row (form, scale, duration, aids, proportion) is included in assessment in every course; it is template boilerplate and not graded-assessment content, and is flagged as boilerplate by the pre-pass (real, but benign: the same row is in the source).
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Table is flattened to a single line in extracted text and .clean_sections() does not strip the fixed header prefix.
findings.suggested_fix: In .clean_sections() strip the fixed header strings 'Vurderingsordning Karakterskala Gruppe/individuell Varighet Hjelpemidler Andel Kommentarer' and 'Form of assessment Grading scale Grouping Duration of assessment Support materials Proportion Comments' from assessment.

findings.evidence: Ingen pensumliste tilgjengelig for dette emnet
findings.description: reading_list rows hold only the site placeholder ('No reading list available for this course' / 'Ingen pensumliste tilgjengelig for dette emnet') in all courses. Pre-pass boilerplate flag is a true positive: no real content. Similarly, prerequisites 'Ingen krav' is emitted in one course while 'None'/'Ingen' is dropped in others (inconsistent).
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: No placeholder filter for reading_list (and prerequisites) in .clean_sections().
findings.suggested_fix: In .clean_sections() drop reading_list rows matching '^(No reading list available|Ingen pensumliste tilgjengelig)' and prerequisites matching '^(None|Ingen( krav)?)\.?$'.
